body:
[Slide 1]
New hire IT onboarding Policy
Wim Goossens, Head of HR
2026-03-01  v3.0

[Slide 2]
Purpose
This policy sets out the rules on new hire it onboarding at Vandenberg Logistics NV.

[Slide 3]
Policy
IT equipment is ordered 10 working days before the start date and the manager sends the welcome plan 5 working days before the start date.

[Slide 4]
Conditions
External contractors follow the separate contractor onboarding flow.

[Slide 5]
Validity
Version 3.0, effective 2025-01-01. Supersedes version 1.2 (2022). Approved by the Management Committee.
